description: Source code for the Dunning doctype in ERPNext, handling overdue notices, interest calculations, and general ledger entries related to dunning processes.

classes.name: Dunning
classes.description: A class representing the Dunning process, extending AccountsController, managing overdue notices, interest calculations, and GL entries.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the Dunning document, including overdue days and amount calculations.

methods.name: validate_overdue_days
methods.description: Calculates overdue days based on posting and due dates.

methods.name: validate_amount
methods.description: Calculates interest and total amounts for overdue invoices.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Triggers GL entries creation upon submission.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Reverses GL entries if the Dunning is canceled.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for overdue invoices.
